# Paired carrier, direct seed and callback element result

The complete Map<K,V> input, direct K seed and Function<? super K,? extends V>
callback retain their independent method scopes and original Object result.
The provider stores the actual callback result and returns a separately observed
opaque value, preventing a predicted compute or returned-value identity.
Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice with source and SDK providers,
compiling every output and auditing all original entries and metadata, including
a methodless marker. Checks cover null/raw inputs, callback identity and argument,
mutation order, partial writes, exact failures and late caller casts.
Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof.
Only authored fixtures execute.
